functions.name: set_light
functions.description: Turn the light in a room on or off. Only for lights and lamps; never for temperature or heating.

room.description: The room whose light to change.

state.description: Whether the light should be on or off.

brightness.description: Light brightness in percent from 0 to 100, only when the user says a percentage or dim/bright. Never a temperature.

functions.name: set_thermostat
functions.description: Set the heating temperature of a room or of the whole house. Use this whenever the user names degrees, a temperature, warmer or colder.

room.description: The room to heat or cool. Omit for the whole home.

temperature.description: Target temperature in degrees Celsius, for example 21. Any number of degrees the user says goes here.

functions.name: set_blinds
functions.description: Open, close or half-open the window blinds in a room.

room.description: The room whose blinds to move.

position.description: The blind position to move to.

functions.name: set_lock
functions.description: Lock or unlock a door of the house.

door.description: Which door to lock or unlock.

state.description: Whether the door should be locked or unlocked.

functions.name: set_scene
functions.description: Activate a scene that sets several devices at once: morning, movie, night or away.

functions.name: get_status
functions.description: Report the current state of the devices in a room, or of the whole home.

room.description: The room to report on. Omit for the whole home.
